name: atoll
description: Design, build, test, run, inspect, and change standing agents that live on Archil disks: work you hand off that stays on duty, keeps its memory in files, and asks you before it acts in your name.

check_on_edit.title: Check the atoll on edit
check_on_edit.description: After Claude writes or edits a file in an atoll project, run atoll check and tell Claude about hard errors only. Silent when the check is clean.
